office: the Department of Immigration (Government of Bermuda)
note: The British Overseas Territories Citizen passport; the fee isn't refunded if the application is refused or withdrawn. The temporary passport of restricted validity (BMD 142, express 105 more) isn't modelled. Validity and the standard processing time are leads.

sources.title: Government of Bermuda (gov.bm), Get a British Overseas Territory passport
sources.said: Fees The following fees apply for the British Overseas Territories Citizen (BOTC) passport: Standard adult passport Standard child (15 years and under) $179.00 $89.00 Issuing a temporary passport of restricted validity (s) $142.00 Providing express passport service for a temporary passport (within 8 business days fee is refundable only if deadline of less than 8 business days is not met) $105.00 ... The application fee is not refundable should the application be refused or withdrawn.
